real-world impact
story.paragraph1: APEX was founded by a group of Year-4 IT engineering students at Norton University. United by the shared vision of using technology to create positive impact, we came together to build real-world projects, learn from each other, and contribute to the Cambodian tech ecosystem.
story.paragraph2: Our name <bold>"APEX"</bold> reflects our mission: to package knowledge and deliver it through code. From web applications to mobile apps, we tackle challenges with a cosmic-level ambition.

experience.a: Not at all! We welcome students, self-taught developers, and anyone passionate about coding. What matters most is your willingness to learn and grow with the team.

paid.a: APEX is a community-driven team focused on learning and building together. Currently, positions are volunteer-based, but team members gain real experience, mentorship, and portfolio projects.

commitment.a: We're flexible. Most members contribute 5-10 hours per week, but you can adjust based on your schedule. We value consistency over quantity.

techStack.q: What tech stack do you use?
techStack.a: Our primary stack is React/Vue.js + Tailwind CSS on the frontend and Laravel + PostgreSQL on the backend, all containerized with Docker. But we are always exploring new technologies.

location.a: We're based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, but work entirely remote. You can contribute from anywhere as long as you communicate and collaborate effectively.

reviewTime.q: How long does the review process take?
reviewTime.a: We typically review applications within 3-5 business days. You'll receive an email with our decision and next steps.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to APEX ("we", "our", or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website <siteLink>www.apex-team.space</siteLink>.

informationWeCollect.title: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We may collect the following types of information:

items.account: <bold>Account Information:</bold> When you register, we collect your name, email address, and password. If you sign in with Google or GitHub, we receive your name, email, and profile picture from those services.
items.profile: <bold>Profile Information:</bold> You may optionally provide a bio, avatar, and social links (GitHub, LinkedIn).
items.usage: <bold>Usage Data:</bold> We automatically collect information about how you interact with our website, including pages visited, time spent, and browser type.
items.contact: <bold>Contact Information:</bold> When you use our contact form, we collect your name, email, and message content.

items.manageAccount: To create and manage your account
items.provideServices: To provide and maintain our services
items.respondInquiries: To respond to your inquiries and contact messages
items.sendUpdates: To send you updates and notifications (with your consent)
items.improveWebsite: To improve our website and user experience
items.protectAbuse: To protect against unauthorized access and abuse

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We use third-party services that may collect information about you:

items.google: <bold>Google OAuth:</bold> For authentication. Subject to <policyLink>Google's Privacy Policy</policyLink>.
items.github: <bold>GitHub OAuth:</bold> For authentication. Subject to <policyLink>GitHub's Privacy Statement</policyLink>.
items.cloudflare: <bold>Cloudflare Turnstile:</bold> For bot protection. Subject to <policyLink>Cloudflare's Privacy Policy</policyLink>.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.

items.access: Access the personal information we hold about you
items.deletion: Request deletion of your personal data
items.withdrawConsent: Withdraw consent for data processing at any time

childrenPrivacy.title: 8. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete it promptly.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our <contactLink>Contact Page</contactLink>.
